Title: Late presentation
GuidanceText: Documents presented after the presentation period or after LC expiry. Cannot be corrected - request a waiver or send on approval basis.

Title: Late shipment
GuidanceText: Shipment effected after the latest shipment date. Not curable by re-presentation; a waiver or an amendment is required.

Title: LC expired
GuidanceText: Credit expired before presentation. Escalate to the treasury manager immediately.

Title: Amount exceeds LC value
GuidanceText: Drawing exceeds the available balance including tolerance. Check for an unrecorded amendment first.

Title: Amount below tolerance
GuidanceText: Drawing below the permitted negative tolerance. Usually acceptable to the applicant.

Title: Invoice value differs from LC
GuidanceText: Invoice total does not agree with the credit or the draft. Recheck the calculation and unit prices.

Title: Description of goods differs
GuidanceText: Goods description on the invoice must correspond with the credit. Other documents may use a general description.

Title: Document missing
GuidanceText: A required document was not presented. Present the missing document within the presentation period if still open.

Title: Insufficient originals or copies
GuidanceText: Number of originals or copies does not match the credit requirement.

Title: Document not signed
GuidanceText: Required signature, stamp or authentication missing.

Title: Document not endorsed
GuidanceText: Transport document not endorsed as required by the credit.

Title: Inconsistent data between documents
GuidanceText: Data in one document conflicts with another. UCP 600 art. 14d requires consistency, not identity.

Title: Spelling or typographical error
GuidanceText: Minor typing errors are generally not discrepancies unless they change meaning. Assess before raising.

Title: Bill of lading not clean
GuidanceText: Transport document bears a clause declaring a defective condition of goods or packing.

Title: Bill of lading not marked freight paid
GuidanceText: Freight payment notation does not match the Incoterm in the credit.

Title: Transshipment not permitted
GuidanceText: Transport document evidences transshipment where the credit prohibits it.

Title: Partial shipment not permitted
GuidanceText: Partial shipment effected where the credit prohibits it.

Title: Port of loading or discharge differs
GuidanceText: Ports shown do not match the credit.

Title: Insurance amount insufficient
GuidanceText: Insurance must cover at least 110 percent of CIF or CIP value unless the credit states otherwise.

Title: Insurance currency differs
GuidanceText: Insurance document must be in the currency of the credit.

Title: Insurance dated after shipment
GuidanceText: Insurance cover must be effective no later than the date of shipment.

Title: Certificate of origin issuer incorrect
GuidanceText: Certificate not issued by the chamber of commerce or authority named in the credit.

Title: Legalisation or attestation missing
GuidanceText: Consular legalisation or embassy attestation required by the credit is absent.

Title: Draft drawn incorrectly
GuidanceText: Tenor, drawee or amount on the bill of exchange does not match the credit.

Title: Other
GuidanceText: Use only when no other category fits, and describe the finding fully.
